profile.name: Robert Haugland
profile.summary: Supply chain leader with 15 years in manufacturing and distribution, the last five running planning, purchasing and logistics for a $480 million packaging business. I build planning processes people actually follow, and I've cut inventory without hurting service at three companies. Looking for a senior supply chain role with a growing manufacturer.

descriptions: Lead planning, purchasing, warehousing and transportation for four plants, with a team of 46 and $210 million in annual spend
Cut inventory by $18 million in two years while raising order fill rate from 93% to 98%
Set up a monthly sales and operations planning meeting that sales, finance and plant leaders run together, with one shared forecast
Moved 60% of freight to two carriers under new contracts, saving $2.6 million a year
Led supplier recovery through the 2021 and 2022 resin shortages, with no missed customer shipments and no air freight
Opened a third-party warehouse in Dallas to serve southern customers, cutting delivery times from four days to two
Ran demand and supply planning for 4,000 parts sold to equipment makers
Moved planning from spreadsheets to an advanced planning system; forecast accuracy rose from 61% to 78% in a year
Built a supplier scorecard for the top 40 suppliers and cut late deliveries by half
Managed a planning team of nine and promoted three planners into supervisor roles
Worked with engineering to retire 700 slow-moving parts
Managed inbound and outbound freight for two distribution centers shipping to 1,200 stores
Introduced a transportation management system and cut freight cost per case by 11%
Redesigned delivery routes for the northern region, removing two trucks from the fleet
Handled carrier contracts and claims, recovering about $400,000 a year in damage claims
Ran the weekly carrier review and replaced two carriers with on-time rates below 90%
Set delivery windows with store operations that cut overtime in store receiving
Planned materials for two assembly lines and kept stockouts below 1% of orders
Built the weekly inventory report used by the plant manager and finance team
Cleaned up lead times and order quantities in the ERP for about 2,500 parts
Represented the planning team on the ERP upgrade project and wrote the test cases for material planning and purchasing screens
Kept the plant's material shortage list and chased late parts with suppliers
Set safety stock levels for the top 300 parts using actual demand variation
Covered purchasing for two buyers during busy seasons and vacations
Scheduled drivers and tracked about 150 loads a day for a regional carrier
Answered customer questions about delays and coordinated with dispatch to fix them
Built an on-time delivery report the operations manager now shares with customers
